$comment: Registered exceptions to Gate 60's single-home rule, enforced by
.github/scripts/verify-single-home-idioms.py at pull-request time --
see specs/049-single-home-release-idioms/contracts/single-home-gate.md.
Each of the four idioms (orphan-reset, failure-issue, verdict-shape,
token-mint) plus the promotion-prevention pass has exactly one home
under .github/actions/_shared/. Every deviation from that lives here,
in the open, with a reason and a tracking issue -- never as a name
missing from a list, and never as a code comment alone.
Every entry is STALE-CHECKED in both directions, the same as Gate 31's
stage-invariant-waivers.json: a pattern that matches nothing fails the
gate, so a waiver cannot outlive its reason. A count that no longer
matches fails the gate, so a waived deviation can neither grow nor
quietly widen.
No waivers were expected to exist at merge time for this feature's own
consolidation (SC-009) -- the two below are PRE-EXISTING patterns Gate
60's structural scan surfaced on its first run against the real tree,
each already reasoned through in its own file's comments, not new debt
this feature introduced. The gate doing exactly this -- finding a
structurally similar but conceptually distinct piece of shell -- is it
working as designed; a human decision belongs here, in the open, not
silently in the gate's own pattern-matching.

waivers.reason: This workflow's own header comment documents the duplication as deliberate: it exists to test the raw actions/create-github-app-token@v3 call independently of e2e-stage, so a regression in the shared scoped-app-token composite cannot silently pass both the diagnostic and the real stage the same way. Routing it through the composite would defeat that independence -- the composite's own bug would then read as 'reachable' in both places at once.

waivers.pattern: gh label create \.\.\. --force \+ gh issue list \.\.\. --jq
waivers.reason: watchdog.yml's usage-limit tracking (create the usage-limit label if absent, look up the one open issue carrying it) is a conceptually different feature from this repository's auto-release:failed/auto-update:failed durable-failure-issue idiom -- a different label, a different lifecycle, no create-or-comment/close split -- that happens to share the same two generic gh-CLI fragments this structural check keys on. Out of scope for specs/049's consolidation; folding it into durable-failure-issue is a separate, future decision.

research.md D1/D2 of specs/049-single-home-release-idioms: auto-update-spec-kit.yml IS a workflow_call-only published stage, and it is ALSO this feature's own declared consumer of the remaining shared composites (scoped-app-token, orphan-branch-reset), reached deliberately through its existing self-checkout convention -- the exact wiring specs/049's own tasks (T011-T013) add. specs/052-agent-credential-lifetime (research.md D8) adds a second, independent call to scoped-app-token immediately after the e2e-stage agent step, to re-mint WC_SCRATCH_TOKEN the same way the pre-agent mint does -- the same declared consumer, not a new promotion. specs/056-stage-found-defect-filing promoted durable-failure-issue out of _shared/ entirely (research.md D8), dropping this count from 4 to 3; a fourth, unrelated _shared/ reference in this file would change it again and fail the gate.

specs/057-autonomous-board-loop tasks.md T021 (repoint pr-conversation.yml's classify-and-announce job at the new wing-commander-size-path-backstop composite) is NOT done in this cycle: the inline jq formula sits inside a per-classification-leg `map()` pipeline that also rewrites category/drafted-content based on the over-threshold result, with no existing behavioral test harness (unlike Gate 4's auto-update-spec-kit-tests) to prove a refactor byte-identical -- repointing it blind, under this cycle's own turn budget, was judged too large a regression risk for a live, production routing decision. board-loop.yml's own route job reaches the formula only through the composite. Remove this waiver when T021 lands.

waivers.pattern: gh workflow run \+ gh run list --workflow= \+ displayTitle \+ \[attempt: co-occurrence
waivers.reason: specs/057-autonomous-board-loop tasks.md T054 (repoint auto-release.yml's dispatch-release job at the new wing-commander-dispatch-and-wait composite) is NOT done in this cycle, and its blocker is specific and checkable: Gate 59 (verify-correlated-release-dispatch.py) checks 3, 4 and 5 assert the correlation search, the tag-state outcome and the wait-for-status all appear in auto-release.yml's OWN raw YAML text -- it is a line-based textual gate over that one file, not an execution harness. Repointing the job moves that shell into the composite and makes Gate 59 fail, so T054 is not a repoint but a coupled redesign of spec 048's own regression gate. dispatch-release also emits six outputs (correlation, correlated-run-id, correlated-run-url, tag-matches, request-time, dispatch-rejected) that its report job branches on, including the three-way found/ambiguous/not-observed distinction and the 90-second fixed wait on the uncorrelated path, none of which this composite's contracted run-url/conclusion pair can carry. board-loop.yml's own prove job reaches the idiom only through the composite. Remove this waiver when T054 lands.

specs/057-autonomous-board-loop research.md D12: the review job's out-of-scope filing uses its OWN fingerprint formula, sha256("<issue>|<norm(title)>|<norm(file_path)>") -- deliberately distinct from spec 056's stage-finding formula (sha256(STAGE|norm(file_path)|norm(gate_or_artifact))) per D11's own explanation for why board review needed a second schema/channel in the first place -- and separately calls verify-board-review-finding-schema.py's validate_finding() (T041) to filter malformed findings, the same discipline spec 056's own D5/D11 use, but against a DIFFERENT schema (board-review-finding.schema.json, not stage-finding.schema.json). The three fragments Gate 60 keys on (sha256, fingerprint_basis, validate_finding) are each genuinely present for a genuinely different, unrelated reason than spec 056's mechanism -- structurally similar shell, conceptually distinct feature, exactly the case this waiver mechanism exists for.
